name: Keystone Electronics Inc.
old_description: Quality can’t be inspected in… It can only be built in. Keystone Electronics’ successful record of servicing their wide customer base since 1989, coupled with an outstanding quality record, continues to set them apart from their competitors. Something else that sets us apart is our ability to produce a quality product in a cost effective manner.
about:
Keystone Electronics Inc. was founded in 1989 in York, Pennsylvania. The company has operated from its South Queen Street facility for more than three decades, building a record of service to a broad customer base. No founders or ownership structure are disclosed in public materials.

The firm specializes in custom electronic assembly, offering electro-mechanical assembly, cable and harness fabrication, printed circuit board assembly, and general contract manufacturing. Its service lineup also includes quality control and ISO 9001 certified processes. Facility size, headcount, and annual volume are not publicly disclosed.

Keystone serves a wide range of industries that require electronic assembly, though specific sectors or named customers are not listed in its public materials. The company emphasizes its ability to support diverse manufacturing needs through its assembly and integration capabilities.

The company’s stated differentiation rests on a philosophy that quality must be built in rather than inspected in, coupled with a focus on delivering cost-effective solutions. Its long track record — over 20 years of experience as of 2019 — and ISO 9001 certification are presented as evidence of consistent quality standards.

old_description: Kimball Electronics is a renowned Electronics Components distribution company with over 100 years of experience in the wholesale distribution business. Founded in 1921, we have established a strong presence in the electromechanical field throughout the years. Our company is certified to the ISO 9001:2015 standard, ensuring the highest quality standards. We offer a wide range of electronic parts and provide competitive quotes for pricing and lead times. about:
Kimball Electronics Inc. was founded in 1921 in Salt Lake City, Utah, as a wholesale distributor of electronic components. The company has operated continuously for over a century, establishing a presence in the electromechanical field and expanding to multiple locations across the Intermountain West.

The firm distributes a broad range of electronic parts and provides value-added services including supply chain solutions, quality assurance testing, and global sourcing. It operates branches in Salt Lake City, Utah; Boise, Idaho; and Lakewood, Colorado, serving customers across those regions. The Salt Lake City branch holds ISO 9001:2015 certification, and the company emphasizes rigorous component testing to ensure reliability.

Kimball Electronics serves customers in the electromechanical and high-end appliance sectors, supplying components for electronic manufacturing and appliance production. Its linecard includes products from a variety of electronic component manufacturers, and the company highlights its ability to source hard-to-find parts.

The company states its mission is to be flexible, responsive, and dedicated as the company of choice for customers, employees, and suppliers through innovative products and process solutions. This mission, along with a stated commitment to excellence and innovation, is presented as the foundation of its long-term customer relationships.

name: Kinney Industries Inc
old_description: Kinney Industries Inc, has been serving the contract electronics manufacturing market since 1972.   The company specializes in manufacturing a wide array of products including: cable and wire harness assemblies, electromechanical assemblies, machined components, and electronic assemblies.
about:
Kinney Industries Inc has operated from Huntsville, Alabama since its founding in 1972. The company is an ISO 9001:2015 and ITAR registered small business serving the contract electronics manufacturing market.

The firm provides a range of manufacturing services including cable and wire harness assemblies (signal, power, and RF cables from prototype to high volume), electromechanical assemblies such as power distribution units, radios, diagnostic equipment, power supplies, and drone tethers, as well as CNC machining (vertical milling, lathe, and plunge/sinker EDM), injection molding using vertical equipment with in-house mold design and machining, over-molding and encapsulation, and engineering services spanning electrical, electronic, mechanical, industrial, and software development. Testing capabilities cover continuity, hi-pot, RF, and customized test programs, supported by the company's proprietary HT-128+ wireless harness tester.

Kinney Industries serves aerospace and defense customers — evidenced by an aerospace case study for the HT-128+ tester — along with electronics, unmanned aerial systems, and telecommunications sectors. Its ITAR registration supports defense-related work, while its product portfolio includes radios, push-to-talk systems, and shelter lighting.

The company differentiates itself through turnkey injection molding solutions, in-house tooling development, and the HT-128+ tester designed to reduce downstream test failures for installed wiring harnesses. It emphasizes short cycle times from concept to production and offers prototyping through full-rate production.

name: Kloeckner Metals Nashville (American Fabricators, Inc.)
old_description: Founded in 1984 and staffed by over 150 skilled associates, the ISO 9001:2015-certified Nashville metal fabrication operation is focused solely on fabrication rather than raw material distribution and ensures top-tier quality through advanced inspection tools, in-house welder training, and a customer-first approach, all backed by the global strength and reliability of Kloeckner Metals.
about:
Kloeckner Metals Nashville operates a 115,000-square-foot sheet metal fabrication facility in Lebanon, Tennessee, about 30 minutes east of Nashville. The operation began in 1984 as American Fabricators, Inc., and today functions as the only Kloeckner Metals site dedicated exclusively to value-added fabrication rather than raw material distribution. It is owned by Kloeckner Metals Corporation, a subsidiary of the German-based Klöckner & Co SE Group.

The plant employs over 150 associates and houses 17 Amada turret punches, four Amada lasers (including 6 kW and 4 kW fiber and two 4 kW CO₂ units), 24 Amada press brakes up to 220 metric tons, a 60-ton robotic press brake, a Panasonic TM-2000WG III robotic welding arm, and a Prima Power BCe Smart Panel Bender. Capabilities span laser cutting, forming, MIG/TIG/resistance spot welding, hardware insertion, mechanical assembly, and metal finishing such as media blasting, tumbling, grinding, graining, and polishing. Materials processed include hot-rolled pickled and oiled, cold rolled, galvanized, galvannealed, aluminized, prepainted, electro-galvanized, aluminum, and stainless steels.

The facility serves the food-service, transportation, HVAC, hot-water-heater, and appliance industries. Examples from the branch include stainless-steel fan mounts for food service, galvanized mounting brackets and door-frame headers for transportation, stainless drain pans and pre-painted galvanized posts for HVAC, hot-rolled plate disc plates for water heaters, and cosmetic stainless parts for appliances.

The company emphasizes its in-house welder qualification program based on AWS D1.1, advanced inspection tools, and a workforce where over half the associates have tenured more than ten years. Special programs include Kanban, stocking, quick-turn prototypes, and PPAP support, all backed by the global supply-chain strength of Kloeckner Metals.

name: Koller-Craft Plastic Products
old_description: Koller Craft, a Koller Enterprises Company, is a family owned and operated full-service provider of injection molded plastic components. Since 1941, we have focused on providing our customers with the highest levels of service and quality. The ‘Craft’ portion of our name was selected by our founder, A.J. Koller Sr., to represent the pride and craftsmanship we feel for our work.
about:
Koller Craft Plastic Products, a division of Koller Enterprises, has operated from Fenton, Missouri since 1941 when A.J. Koller Sr. founded the company as a custom molder. The family-owned business, now in its third generation, adopted the "Craft" name to reflect the pride and craftsmanship its founder valued. The company maintains a second facility in Gadsden, Alabama.

The molder provides full-service injection molding of plastic components, running 53 presses ranging from 80 to 2,200 tons across 345,000 square feet of manufacturing space. Its capabilities include gas-assist molding, over-molding, manual and automated assembly, and decorating services such as hot stamping. The company also offers engineering support with design optimization and rapid prototyping, material sourcing, and tooling maintenance. A combined workforce of approximately 205 employees supports these operations.

Koller Craft serves the automotive, agriculture and lawn & garden, general industrial, and material handling sectors. Its customer base includes original equipment manufacturers such as Watlow Electric Manufacturing Company, whose logo appears on the company's website with permission.

The company emphasizes its ISO 9001 certification, held since April 2003, and a total quality system guided by 80/20 principles. Domestic production is cited as a differentiator, enabling quicker delivery and rapid problem resolution, while a focus on on-time shipping and quick problem resolution rounds out its value proposition.

name: Landmark Manufacturing Corporation
old_description: Landmark was founded in 1953. Since then, we have fabricated thousands of different components for hundreds of customers. For more than 60 years, we have been using state-of-the-art innovative processes.
about:
Landmark Manufacturing Corporation operates from Gallatin, Missouri, where it was founded in 1953 by the Critten family as Longwood Furnace. The business began as a furnace company before expanding into nationwide distribution in 1974 and entering the metal fabrication subcontracting market in 1978. After a sale in 1986, the company was renamed Landmark Manufacturing Corporation and has remained a privately held manufacturer.

Today Landmark provides custom metal fabrication with start-to-finish capabilities that include stamping (presses up to 2,000 tons), robotic welding, laser cutting, horizontal machining, CNC press braking, electrostatic E-Coat painting, and assembly. The facility spans more than 650,000 square feet and houses stamping, forming, bending, welding, tooling, engineering, quality control, warehousing, and shipping departments. The company reports having fabricated thousands of different components for hundreds of customers over its history.

Its customer base includes manufacturers of agricultural and construction equipment (Kubota), outdoor power equipment (Excel Industries), and commercial trailers (Meritor), as evidenced by supplier awards from those companies. Landmark serves a range of industrial sectors requiring heavy-gauge metal stampings, welded assemblies, and finished components.

The company emphasizes a total quality management system certified to ISO 9001:2015, with in-house precision measurement using FARO Edge 7-axis arms and Scantech 3D scanners. Its stated mission focuses on on-time delivery, continuous improvement, and long-term partnerships with customers and suppliers.

name: Linear Manufactureing
old_description: Linear Manufacturing is an AS9100:2016-ISO 9001:2015 certified full service contract manufacturer for electronics and serves clients in many market segments for original equipment manufacturers (OEM’s). Linear has been based in Colorado Springs since 1995.
about:
Linear Manufacturing has operated from Colorado Springs, Colorado since its founding in 1995. The company began with a vision to produce low-volume, high-mix electronic products and has remained at the same Elkton Drive address throughout its history. Ownership structure and founder names are not publicly disclosed.

The company provides full-service electronics contract manufacturing, spanning surface-mount technology (SMT) assembly, through-hole assembly, mixed-technology PCB assembly, box build, and rapid prototyping. Its SMT lines handle components down to 0.0402 package size, with plans to reach 0.0201, and support both low- and high-volume throughput, single- and double-sided placement, BGA placement and rework, and fine-pitch placement. Engineering design services are delivered through a long-standing partnership with KS Technologies, a Colorado Springs firm specializing in mobile hardware accessories, applications, and cloud services; both companies hold Apple MFi certification. Linear also offers design-for-manufacturing (DFM), design-for-test (DFT), and design-for-assembly (DFA) support, turnkey and consigned material management, statistical process control, and comprehensive inspection and test. The facility employs IPC-610 certified operators, though total headcount is not published.

Linear serves original equipment manufacturers across aerospace, oil and gas, medical devices, Bluetooth and GPS technology, water and wastewater treatment, security devices, controllers, sensors, cleaning equipment, and irrigation controllers. Case studies illustrate work for an oil and gas company needing pipeline-monitoring electronics, an asset-tracking startup that met a Consumer Electronics Show deadline, a medical device firm achieving FDA compliance on legacy boards, an aerospace customer requiring legacy product duplication with counterfeit-part prevention, and a wastewater treatment company completing an abandoned design.

The company states its differentiation lies in turnkey solutions that free customers to focus on innovation, strategic supplier alliances that improve pricing and accountability, a commitment to U.S.-based manufacturing at high quality standards, and a culture described as "real people doing business with real people."

name: Lone Star Circuits
old_description: Lone Star Circuits offers a wide range of close-tolerance CNC machining services. We have extensive experience with materials ranging from aluminum to titanium. With our state-of-the-art CNC vertical milling and turning centers capable of positioning accuracy/full stroke +/-0.00008 and repeatability+/-0.00004 combined with our manufacturing experience makes Lone Star Mfg. your total solution for precision machining in the 21st century.
about:
Lone Star Circuits was founded in 1986 in Wylie, Texas, and operates as a privately held manufacturer of printed circuit boards and precision-machined components. The company has grown to a 101,000-square-foot facility with a staff of 55 employees.

The company specializes in high-reliability PCB fabrication, including multilayer PTFE bonding, flex and rigid-flex circuits, metal-backed boards, HDI and sequential lamination, cavity constructions, and three-dimensional shaped circuitry. An in-house machine shop provides CNC vertical milling and turning with positioning accuracy of ±0.00008 in and repeatability of ±0.00004 in, alongside YAG/CO2 laser drilling, copper-filled microvias, and automated VIP hole fill. Panel sizes up to 24×50 inches are supported, with trace/space capabilities down to 0.003 in and controlled impedance held to ±3%. Surface finishes range from ENIG and ENEPIG to immersion silver, wire-bondable gold, hard nickel/gold, HASL, and tin-lead reflow.

Lone Star Circuits serves the military, aerospace, and defense sectors, with customers including Lockheed Martin, Northrop Grumman, RTX, and General Dynamics, as well as transportation companies such as Alstom. The firm is ITAR-registered and holds certifications to ISO 9001:2015, AS9100D, MIL-PRF-31032, and IPC standards.

The company emphasizes vertical integration, offering in-house machining, metal-backed PCB production, and rapid lead times of 24 hours to 15 days. Its focus on advanced PTFE hybrid packaging for manifolds, radiators, antennas, radomes, and tiles, combined with heavy copper capability above 5 oz, positions it for high-power RF and thermal-management applications.

name: M Plastics Inc.
old_description: At M Plastics, we take pride in being a family-owned manufacturer that offers comprehensive all-in-one services. From extrusion and printing to bag making, we handle every step of the process with care and expertise. Our commitment to quality and customer satisfaction drives us to deliver exceptional products tailored to your packaging needs. Trust us to be your reliable partner in manufacturing solutions.
about:
M Plastics Inc. is a family-owned manufacturer based in Los Angeles, California, founded in 2005. The company began as a custom poly bag and film operation, keeping every production step under one roof.

The company provides full-service custom poly bag and film manufacturing, including in-house LDPE extrusion, flexographic printing up to six colors, and bag making. Its Los Angeles facility produces flat bags, gusseted bags, wicket bags, bread bags, ice bags, rock bags, anti-static bags, suffocation warning bags, baler bags, as well as LDPE film, poly tubing, shrink film, stretch wrap, custom sheeting, box liners, drum liners, pallet covers, furniture bags, VCI corrosion protection liners, and trash liners. All products are made to order with nationwide shipping from the same site.

M Plastics serves a broad range of industries, including meat and protein, poultry, seafood, bakery, produce and grocery, frozen foods, food processing, manufacturing, pharmaceutical, agriculture, construction, e-commerce, retail and apparel, electronics and ESD, and landscaping. The company emphasizes food-grade material options for food processors and manufacturers across the country.

The company highlights its differentiators as full in-house control from raw LDPE resin to finished product, third-party audited quality systems (ISO 9001:2015 and FSSC 22000), custom printing capabilities, and competitive lead times on both custom and stock orders. Its family-owned structure and commitment to quality and customer satisfaction drive its approach to tailored packaging solutions.
